name: Park Hyatt Mendoza Hotel
positioning: City-center Park Hyatt (officially Park Hyatt Mendoza, Hotel, Casino & Spa) opposite Plaza Independencia, with an on-site casino and a spa using olive- and wine-based treatments
best_for: Travelers who want a central Mendoza base opposite Plaza Independencia
Guests interested in spa treatments based on olives and wine
Travelers planning outdoor trips such as trekking and mountain tours

facts.text: The hotel is in Mendoza's city center, opposite the historic Plaza Independencia.
The hotel has an on-site casino, Casino Dreams Plaza, with slot machines, gaming tables and a VIP room.
Kaua Club & Spa has a sauna and a Turkish steam bath.
Bistro M serves a menu inspired by Mendocinian cuisine.
UVAS Lounge & Bar is the hotel's pool bar.
Balcony Bar is on the first floor and serves an international menu from tapas to signature cocktails and wine.
Room service is available around the clock.
Rooms are decorated in an understated, contemporary style with light furnishings, local artwork and earthy palettes.
Mountain-view rooms look out to the Andes.
Guests can enjoy outdoor experiences ranging from an Aconcagua expedition to trekking and mountain tours.

highlights.text: The hotel's Balcony of the Arts displays sculptures, paintings and other works from Mendoza, including work by Julio Le Parc.
Bistro M's wine cellar is two stories high.
Kaua Club & Spa offers olive- and wine-based treatments and products.
At Bistro M, vegetables, fish and meats are roasted in a wood-burning oven visible in the open kitchen.
Diner Plaza, on the casino's lower level, is a restaurant inspired by the famous diners of the 1950s.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the urban setting may not appeal to guests seeking a secluded wine country retreat.
The hotel is pet friendly, but pet-friendly rooms should be reserved at least three days before arrival.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
